replacement: Who or what the action belongs to follows with *de*: *la llegada de Yesid*, *la venta del edificio*. The English "Yesid's arrival" turns around. When you name both the thing done and the doer, the doer takes *por parte de*: *la compra del edificio por parte de Altamira*.

replacement: After a past first verb, use the *-ra* form. In parts of Latin America you'll also hear *vengas* when the coming is still ahead, but *vinieras* is always right.
